--[[
    The Mimic - Universal Chat Mimic Script
    Name: The Mimic
    Features: Compact UI, Partial Name Matching, 0.4s Human Delay
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local TargetPlayer = nil
local IsMimicking = false
local Connection = nil

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CHAT SENDER HELPER (Handles both Legacy & TextChatService)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function SendChatMessage(msg)
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
        if generalChannel then
            generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
        end
    else
        local defaultChatSystemChatEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        if defaultChatSystemChatEvents then
            local sayMessageRequest = defaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if sayMessageRequest then
                sayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
            end
        end
    end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI CREATION (Compact Size)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "TheMimic_UI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(ScreenGui)
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
else
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 115) -- Made significantly smaller & tighter
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.4, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
Corner.Parent = MainFrame

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
Stroke.Thickness = 1.2
Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Stroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- Title Header
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "THE MIMIC"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 12
Title.Parent = MainFrame

-- TextBox for Username Input
local NameInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
NameInput.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0, 26)
NameInput.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.3, 0)
NameInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
NameInput.PlaceholderText = "Player Name..."
NameInput.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
NameInput.Text = ""
NameInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
NameInput.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
NameInput.TextSize = 11
NameInput.ClearTextOnFocus = false
NameInput.Parent = MainFrame

local InputCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
InputCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
InputCorner.Parent = NameInput

-- Toggle Action Button
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0, 30)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.63, 0)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
ToggleBtn.Text = "START MIMIC"
ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ToggleBtn.TextSize = 11
ToggleBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
BtnCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PLAYER MATCHING LOGIC
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function GetPlayerByPartialName(str)
    if str == "" then return nil end
    local query = string.lower(str)
    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            if string.find(string.lower(plr.Name), query) or string.find(string.lower(plr.DisplayName), query) then
                return plr
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MIMIC ENGINE (0.4s Delay)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function StartMimicking(plr)
    TargetPlayer = plr
    Connection = TargetPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
        if IsMimicking then
            task.wait(0.4) -- Adjusted to 0.4 seconds
            SendChatMessage(msg)
        end
    end)
end

local function StopMimicking()
    if Connection then
        Connection:Disconnect()
        Connection = nil
    end
    TargetPlayer = nil
end

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    IsMimicking = not IsMimicking
    
    if IsMimicking then
        local foundPlayer = GetPlayerByPartialName(NameInput.Text)
        if foundPlayer then
            StartMimicking(foundPlayer)
            ToggleBtn.Text = "MIMICKING..."
            ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
        else
            IsMimicking = false
            ToggleBtn.Text = "NOT FOUND!"
            task.wait(1)
            ToggleBtn.Text = "START MIMIC"
        end
    else
        StopMimicking()
        ToggleBtn.Text = "START MIMIC"
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    end
end)

local function CIORJCJ_script() -- Frame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	function dragify(Main)
		dragToggle = nil
		dragSpeed = 0.95 -- You can edit this.
		dragInput = nil
		dragStart = nil
		dragPos = nil
	
		function updateInput(input)
			Delta = input.Position - dragStart
			Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + Delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(.25), {Position = Position}):Play()
		end
	
		Main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				dragToggle = true
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos = Main.Position
				input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End) then
						dragToggle = false
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	
		Main.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				dragInput = input
			end
		end)
	
		game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if (input == dragInput and dragToggle) then
				updateInput(input)
			end
		end)
	end
	
	dragify(script.Parent)
	
	
end

local function JJLB_script() -- disco.Script 
	local script = Instance.new('Script', disco)

	script.Parent.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
		local ColorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
	
		function zigzag(X) 
			return math.acos(math.cos(X*math.pi))/math.pi
		end
	
		Counter = 0
	
		Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00"
	
		while wait(0.1) do 
			ColorCorrection.TintColor = Color3.fromHSV(zigzag(Counter),1,1)
			Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromHSV(zigzag(Counter),1,1)
			Counter += 0.01
		end
	end)
	
end

scripts.code:
-- =====================================================================
-- Fust Survival Fucker | Splix UI (Drawing-based)
-- =====================================================================
local Library, utility, pointers, theme = loadstring(game:HttpGet(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/matas3535/PoopLibrary/main/Library.lua"
))()
-- Если URL недоступен: local Library, utility, pointers, theme = loadfile("Library.lua")()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS     = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CS      = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RS      = game:GetService("RunService")
local WS      = game:GetService("Workspace")

local lp  = Players.LocalPlayer
local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
WS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function() cam = WS.CurrentCamera end)

local newc  = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
local check = checkcaller  or function() return false end

-- =====================================================================
-- STATE
-- =====================================================================
local state = {
    silentAim = false, silentAimFov = 250, silentAimHitPart = "Head",
    autoCross = false,
    aimbot = false, aimbotSmooth = 0.2, aimbotHitPart = "Head", aimbotFov = 150,
    aimAssist = false, aimAssistStrength = 0.08, aimAssistFovDeg = 10,

    playerEsp = false, npcEsp = false, entityEsp = false, tracers = false,
    longNeck = false, longNeckAmount = 5,
    espColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
    entityColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60),
    tracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
    espRainbow = false, tracerRainbow = false,

    bulletTracers = false,
    bulletTracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80),
    bulletTracerRainbow = false,
    bulletTracerLifetime = 0.4,

    fullbright = false,
    fovChanger = false, fovValue = 70,
    crosshair = false,
    crosshairColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    crosshairSize = 8,

    fovCircle = false,
    fovCircleColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),

    friendly = {},
}

local function rainbowColor(speed, offset)
    return Color3.fromHSV((tick() * (speed or 0.5) + (offset or 0)) % 1, 1, 1)
end
local function isFriendly(player)
    return player and state.friendly[player.Name] == true
end

-- =====================================================================
-- HELPERS
-- =====================================================================
local function getCharRoot()
    local c = lp.Character
    return c, c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getCrosshair()
    local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
    if UIS.TouchEnabled or not UIS.MouseEnabled or UIS.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
        return Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
    end
    return UIS:GetMouseLocation()
end
local function getPartForModel(model, partName)
    if not model then return nil end
    if partName == "Head" then return model:FindFirstChild("Head") end
    if partName == "Torso" then return model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") end
    return model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Head")
end

local function getAllTargets()
    local list, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(m)
        if not m or m == lp.Character or seen[m] or not m:IsA("Model") then return end
        seen[m] = true
        local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local head = m:FindFirstChild("Head") or m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 and head then
            table.insert(list, { model = m, head = head, hum = hum })
        end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp and p.Character and not isFriendly(p) then add(p.Character) end
    end
    for _, fname in ipairs({ "Npcs", "Animals" }) do
        local f = WS:FindFirstChild(fname)
        if f then for _, m in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do add(m) end end
    end
    for _, tag in ipairs({ "FustNpc", "FustAnimal", "FustDino" }) do
        for _, m in ipairs(CS:GetTagged(tag)) do add(m) end
    end
    return list
end

local function getPlayersOnly()
    local out = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p == lp or isFriendly(p) then continue end
        local char = p.Character
        if not char then continue end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head then table.insert(out, { model = char, head = head, player = p }) end
    end
    return out
end

-- =====================================================================
-- ENTITY ESP
-- =====================================================================
local function isEntityName(name)
    local n = name:lower()
    return n:find("dead bag") or n:find("deadbag")
        or n:find("backpack") or n:find("back pack")
        or n:find("loot bag") or n:find("lootbag")
end
local function getEntities()
    local list, seen = {}, {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(WS:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and isEntityName(obj.Name) and not seen[obj] then
            seen[obj] = true
            local part = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part then table.insert(list, { model = obj, part = part }) end
        elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") and isEntityName(obj.Name) and not seen[obj.Parent] then
            seen[obj.Parent] = true
            table.insert(list, { model = obj.Parent, part = obj })
        end
    end
    return list
end

-- =====================================================================
-- WEAK SPOT / BALLISTICS
-- =====================================================================
local function getBestWeakSpot(hitPart)
    local _, root = getCharRoot()
    if not root then return nil, nil end
    local rPos = root.Position
    if hitPart and hitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
        local node = hitPart.Parent
        while node and node ~= WS do
            if CS:HasTag(node, "FustNode") or node:GetAttribute("NodeType") ~= nil then
                local wsSpot = node:GetAttribute("WeakSpot")
                if typeof(wsSpot) == "Vector3" then return hitPart, wsSpot end
                break
            end
            node = node.Parent
        end
    end
    local bestPart, bestSpot, minDistSq = nil, nil, 196
    for _, node in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("FustNode")) do
        if node:IsDescendantOf(WS) and node:GetAttribute("Depleted") ~= true then
            local wsSpot = node:GetAttribute("WeakSpot")
            if typeof(wsSpot) == "Vector3" then
                local d = rPos - wsSpot
                local dSq = d.X*d.X + d.Y*d.Y + d.Z*d.Z
                if dSq < minDistSq then
                    minDistSq = dSq
                    bestPart  = node:FindFirstChild("Rock") or node:FindFirstChild("Trunk")
                        or node:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or node.PrimaryPart
                    bestSpot  = wsSpot
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPart, bestSpot
end

local function getWeaponStats()
    local char = lp.Character
    local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    local name = tool and tool.Name:lower() or ""
    if name:find("bow") or name:find("crossbow")                   then return 260, 150 end
    if name:find("revolver") or name:find("pistol") or name:find("smg") then return 450, 110 end
    if name:find("sniper") or name:find("bolt")                    then return 800,  70 end
    if name:find("rifle") or name:find("sar") or name:find("ak")    then return 650,  90 end
    return 550, 100
end

local targetVelocities, lastTargetPositions, lastVelTime = {}, {}, os.clock()
RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local now = os.clock()
    local dt  = now - lastVelTime
    if dt < 0.05 then return end
    lastVelTime = now
    for _, t in ipairs(getAllTargets()) do
        local h    = t.head
        local last = lastTargetPositions[h]
        if last then targetVelocities[h] = (h.Position - last) / dt end
        lastTargetPositions[h] = h.Position
    end
end)

-- =====================================================================
-- TARGET FINDERS
-- =====================================================================
local function getSilentAimTarget()
    if not cam then return nil end
    local curPos, minDist, best = getCrosshair(), state.silentAimFov, nil
    for _, t in ipairs(getAllTargets()) do
        local part = getPartForModel(t.model, state.silentAimHitPart) or t.head
        local sPos = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if sPos.Z > 0 then
            local dx, dy = sPos.X - curPos.X, sPos.Y - curPos.Y
            local d = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
            if d < minDist then minDist = d; best = part end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function getAimbotTarget()
    if not cam then return nil end
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    local best, bestDist = nil, state.aimbotFov
    for _, t in ipairs(getPlayersOnly()) do
        local part = getPartForModel(t.model, state.aimbotHitPart) or t.head
        local sPos = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if sPos.Z > 0 then
            local d = (Vector2.new(sPos.X, sPos.Y) - center).Magnitude
            if d <= bestDist then bestDist = d; best = part end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function getAimAssistTarget()
    if not cam then return nil end
    local best = nil
    for _, t in ipairs(getPlayersOnly()) do
        local part = getPartForModel(t.model, "Head") or t.head
        local toTarget = (part.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Unit
        if cam.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(toTarget) > math.cos(math.rad(state.aimAssistFovDeg)) then
            if not best or (part.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < (best.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude then
                best = part
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- =====================================================================
-- BULLET TRACERS
-- =====================================================================
local hasDrawing = (type(Drawing) == "table" and type(Drawing.new) == "function")
local bulletTracerPool = {}

local function spawnBulletTracer(fromPos, toPos)
    if not hasDrawing or not state.bulletTracers then return end
    local line = table.remove(bulletTracerPool) or Drawing.new("Line")
    line.From = fromPos; line.To = toPos
    line.Color = state.bulletTracerRainbow and rainbowColor() or state.bulletTracerColor
    line.Thickness = 2; line.Transparency = 1; line.Visible = true
    local startTime = tick()
    task.spawn(function()
        while tick() - startTime < state.bulletTracerLifetime do
            local elapsed = tick() - startTime
            line.Transparency = 1 - (elapsed / state.bulletTracerLifetime)
            task.wait(0.03)
        end
        line.Visible = false; line.Transparency = 1
        table.insert(bulletTracerPool, line)
    end)
end

-- =====================================================================
-- NAMECALL HOOK
-- =====================================================================
local oldNamecall
local function namecallHook(self, ...)
    if check() then return oldNamecall(self, ...) end
    local rawMethod = getnamecallmethod and getnamecallmethod()
    local method    = rawMethod and rawMethod:lower() or ""
    if method == "fireserver" then
        if self.Name == "Swing" and state.autoCross then
            local args = { ... }
            local payload = typeof(args[1]) == "table" and args[1] or {}
            local nodePart, weakSpot = getBestWeakSpot(payload.target)
            if weakSpot then
                payload.target = payload.target or nodePart
                payload.pos    = weakSpot
                if setnamecallmethod and rawMethod then setnamecallmethod(rawMethod) end
                return oldNamecall(self, payload)
            end
        elseif self.Name == "Shoot" then
            if state.bulletTracers and cam then
                local args = { ... }
                local payload = typeof(args[1]) == "table" and args[1] or {}
                local origin = typeof(payload.origin) == "Vector3" and payload.origin or cam.CFrame.Position
                local dir = typeof(payload.dir) == "Vector3" and payload.dir or cam.CFrame.LookVector
                local hitPos = origin + dir * 1000
                local sPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hitPos)
                if onScreen and sPos.Z > 0 then
                    spawnBulletTracer(Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y),
                                      Vector2.new(sPos.X, sPos.Y))
                end
            end
            if state.silentAim then
                local target = getSilentAimTarget()
                if target then
                    local args    = { ... }
                    local payload = typeof(args[1]) == "table" and args[1] or {}
                    local origin  = typeof(payload.origin) == "Vector3" and payload.origin or (cam and cam.CFrame.Position)
                    if origin then
                        local speed, grav = getWeaponStats()
                        local vel = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        if not vel or vel.Magnitude < 0.5 then vel = targetVelocities[target] or Vector3.zero end
                        local aimPos = target.Position
                        local t = (aimPos - origin).Magnitude / speed
                        aimPos = aimPos + vel * t + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * grav * t * t, 0)
                        t = (aimPos - origin).Magnitude / speed
                        aimPos = target.Position + vel * t + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * grav * t * t, 0)
                        payload.dir = (aimPos - origin).Unit
                        if setnamecallmethod and rawMethod then setnamecallmethod(rawMethod) end
                        return oldNamecall(self, payload)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if setnamecallmethod and rawMethod then setnamecallmethod(rawMethod) end
    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end
if hookmetamethod then
    oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newc(namecallHook))
else
    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
    setreadonly(mt, false)
    mt.__namecall = newc(namecallHook)
    setreadonly(mt, true)
end

    local hl = espCache[model]

local function repositionSizePanel()
    if not sizePanel or not radarContainer then return end

    sizePanel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(

    currentRadarSize = math.clamp(newSize, RADAR_MIN_SIZE, RADAR_MAX_SIZE)
    if radarScale then
        radarScale.Scale = currentRadarSize / CONFIG.HUD_SIZE
    end
    if sizePanel and sizePanel.Visible then
        updateSliderVisuals()

    if not sizeSliderBar then return end
    local barY = sizeSliderBar.AbsolutePosition.Y
    local barH = sizeSliderBar.AbsoluteSize.Y
    if barH <= 0 then return end
    local rel = math.clamp((screenY - barY) / barH, 0, 1)
    local newSize = RADAR_MAX_SIZE - rel * (RADAR_MAX_SIZE - RADAR_MIN_SIZE)
    applyRadarSize(newSize)
end

    if not radarDragging then return end
    if input ~= radarDragInput then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Delta
        local pos = radarContainer.Position
        radarContainer.Position = UDim2.new(
            pos.X.Scale,
            pos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            pos.Y.Scale,
            pos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
        repositionSizePanel()
    end
end))

    if input ~= radarDragInput then return end

        radarDragging = false
        radarDragInput = nil
    end
end))

local function scan()
    if not radarDisplay then return end
    local char = player.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then nearestDist = nil; return end

    local playerPos = hrp.Position
    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local camCF
    if camera then
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.01 then
            flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        end
        flatLook = flatLook.Unit
        camCF = CFrame.new(playerPos, playerPos + flatLook)
    else
        camCF = hrp.CFrame
    end

    local R = CONFIG.RANGE
    local nearest = nil
    table.clear(targets)

    local function consider(root)
        local pos = root.Position
        local rel = camCF:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
        local dist = (pos - playerPos).Magnitude
        if dist > R then return end
        if not nearest or dist < nearest then nearest = dist end
        table.insert(targets, {
            nx = 0.5 + rel.X / (2 * R),
            ny = 0.5 + rel.Z / (2 * R),
            dist = dist,
        })
    end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player then
            local c = plr.Character
            local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then consider(root) end
        end
    end

    if CONFIG.TRACK_NPCS then
        for hum in pairs(npcs) do
            local model = hum.Parent
            if model and hum.Health > 0 and model ~= char and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
                local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
                if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then consider(root) end
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(targets, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    nearestDist = nearest

    for i = 1, MAX_BLIPS do
        local entry = radarDisplay.blips[i]
        local t = targets[i]
        if t then
            entry.dot.Visible = true
            entry.dot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(t.nx, t.ny)
        else
            entry.dot.Visible = false
            entry.stroke.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

local function beepInterval(dist)
    local t = math.clamp(1 - dist / CONFIG.RANGE, 0, 1)
    return CONFIG.BEEP_FAR + (CONFIG.BEEP_NEAR - CONFIG.BEEP_FAR) * t, t
end

beepSound = create("Sound", {
    Name = "RadarBeep",
    SoundId = CONFIG.BEEP_ID,
    Volume = CONFIG.BEEP_VOLUME,
    RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear,
}, SoundService)

track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if radarEnabled and radarDisplay then
        sweepAngle = (sweepAngle + CONFIG.SWEEP_SPEED * dt) % 360
        radarDisplay.sweepHolder.Rotation = sweepAngle

        pulseT = (pulseT + dt * CONFIG.PULSE_SPEED) % 1
        radarDisplay.pulseRing.Size = UDim2.fromScale(pulseT, pulseT)
        radarDisplay.pulseStroke.Transparency = pulseT

        scanAcc += dt
        if scanAcc >= CONFIG.SCAN_RATE then
            scanAcc = 0
            scan()
        end

        local hasEnemy = #targets > 0

        if hasEnemy then
            radarDisplay.stroke.Color = COL_DANGER
            radarDisplay.status.Text = "ENEMY DETECTED"
            radarDisplay.status.TextColor3 = COL_DANGER
            radarDisplay.sweepLine.BackgroundColor3 = COL_DANGER
            radarDisplay.pulseStroke.Color = COL_DANGER
        else
            radarDisplay.stroke.Color = COL_ACCENT
            radarDisplay.status.Text = "SAFE ZONE"
            radarDisplay.status.TextColor3 = COL_ACCENT
            radarDisplay.sweepLine.BackgroundColor3 = COL_ACCENT
            radarDisplay.pulseStroke.Color = COL_ACCENT
        end

        if hasEnemy and wasEmpty then
            radarDisplay.detectStroke.Thickness = 10
            radarDisplay.detectStroke.Transparency = 0
            TweenService:Create(
                radarDisplay.detectStroke,
                TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { Thickness = 0, Transparency = 1 }
            ):Play()
        end
        wasEmpty = not hasEnemy

        local first = radarDisplay.blips[1]
        if hasEnemy and first.dot.Visible then
            local p = (math.sin(tick() * 6) + 1) / 2
            first.stroke.Enabled = true
            first.stroke.Transparency = 0.2 + (1 - p) * 0.6
        else
            first.stroke.Enabled = false
        end
    end

    if soundEnabled and radarEnabled and nearestDist then
        local interval, t = beepInterval(nearestDist)
        beepAcc += dt
        if beepAcc >= interval then
            beepAcc = 0
            beepSound.PlaybackSpeed = CONFIG.PITCH_FAR + (CONFIG.PITCH_NEAR - CONFIG.PITCH_FAR) * t
            beepSound:Play()
        end
    else
        beepAcc = math.huge
    end
end))

local ButtonContainer = create("Frame", {

create("UIListLayout", {

local function styleButton(btn, isOn)
    local stroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if isOn then
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = BTN_ON_BG
        btn.TextColor3 = BTN_ON_TEXT
        if stroke then stroke.Color = BTN_ON_STROKE end
    else

end

local function makeToggleButton(text, order)

    create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, btn)

    return btn
end

local function animate(object, properties)

        object,
        TweenInfo.new(TWEEN_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        properties
    ):Play()
end

track(MinimizeButton.Activated:Connect(function()

    else

track(MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

end))

track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not hubDragInput then return end
    if input ~= hubDragInput then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Delta
        local pos = MainFrame.Position
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(

            pos.X.Offset + delta.X,

end))

scripts.title: Double Tap | CDT
scripts.author: Neless
scripts.summary: New script for Car Dealership Tycoon
scripts.code:
local SOURCE = [==[
if game.PlaceId ~= 1554960397 then return end
local P = game:GetService("Players")
local R = game:GetService("RunService")
local U = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local W = game:GetService("Workspace")
local H = game:GetService("HttpService")
local T = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local LP = P.LocalPlayer
local G = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
if type(G.DT_Stop) == "function" then pcall(G.DT_Stop) end
if G.DT_UI then pcall(function() G.DT_UI:Destroy() end) end

local S = {
 Pumpkin=false, Boss=false, Common=true, Rare=true, Legendary=true,
 Crystals=false, Mailboxes=false, AutoSwap=false, CarBoost=false,
 CarFly=false, AutoFlip=false, PlayerFly=false, InfiniteJump=false,
 Noclip=false, FarmDelay=0.05, CarSpeed=500, FlyCarSpeed=250,
 PlayerSpeed=16, FlyPlayerSpeed=150, JumpPower=50, GuiScale=0.85
}

local visited = {}

if type(G.DT_Restore) == "string" then
 local ok,data = pcall(function()
  return H:JSONDecode(G.DT_Restore)
 end)
 if ok and type(data)=="table" then
  for k,v in pairs(data.settings or {}) do
   if S[k] ~= nil and type(S[k]) == type(v) then S[k] = v end
  end
  if type(data.visited)=="table" then visited=data.visited end
  S.Pumpkin=true
  S.Boss=false
  S.AutoSwap=false
  S.FarmDelay=0.05
 end
 G.DT_Restore=nil
end

local running=true
local conn={}
local recent=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local collisions=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local found={Pumpkin={},Boss={},Crystals={},Mailboxes={}}
local lastScan=0
local activePlayer,activeCar,playerV,playerG,carV,carG
local ray,touchGui,scaleObj
local buttons={}
local pressed={Up=false,Down=false}
local touchKeys={}
local controls

local function char()
 return LP.Character
end

local function humanoid()
 local c=char()
 return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function root()
 local c=char()
 return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function vehicle()
 local h=humanoid()
 local seat=h and h.SeatPart
 if not seat or not seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
  return nil,nil
 end
 local m=seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
 while m and m.Parent and m.Parent:IsA("Model") do
  m=m.Parent
 end
 return m,seat
end

local function notify(msg)
 if ray then
  pcall(function()
   ray:Notify({
    Title="Double Tap v2 | CDT",
    Content=msg,
    Duration=4
   })
  end)
 end
end

local function match(o,terms,n)
 for _=1,n or 2 do
  if not o or o==W then break end
  local name=o.Name:lower()
  for _,term in ipairs(terms) do
   if name:find(term,1,true) then return true end
  end
  o=o.Parent
 end
 return false
end

local function scan()
 local nextFound={Pumpkin={},Boss={},Crystals={},Mailboxes={}}
 local seen={}
 for _,o in ipairs(W:GetDescendants()) do
  if o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Parent and not (char() and o:IsDescendantOf(char())) then
   local key=o.Parent:IsA("Model") and o.Parent or o
   local n=o.Name:lower()
   local pn=o.Parent.Name:lower()
   local category

   if match(o,{"pumpkinboss","pumpkin_boss","pumpkin boss"},3) then
    category="Boss"
   elseif (n:find("pumpkin",1,true) or pn:find("pumpkin",1,true)
    or n:find("jackolantern",1,true)) and o.Size.Magnitude<30
    and not match(o,{"decor","display","fake","shop","preview"},3) then
    category="Pumpkin"
   elseif (n:find("crystal",1,true) or pn:find("crystal",1,true))
    and o.Size.Magnitude<35 then
    category="Crystals"
   end

   if category and not seen[key] then
    seen[key]=true
    table.insert(nextFound[category],o)
   end

   if n:find("mailbox",1,true) then
    table.insert(nextFound.Mailboxes,o)
   end
  end
 end
 found=nextFound
 lastScan=os.clock()
end

local function rarity(o)
 if match(o,{"legendary","purple","epic"},3) then
  return "Legendary"
 end
 if match(o,{"rare","dark"},3) then
  return "Rare"
 end
 local h,s,v=o.Color:ToHSV()
 if s>0.3 and h>0.69 and h<0.89 then
  return "Legendary"
 end
 if v<0.28 then return "Rare" end
 return "Common"
end

local function target(category)
 if os.clock()-lastScan>2 then scan() end
 local r=root()
 if not r then return nil end
 local best,score

 for _,o in ipairs(found[category]) do
  if o.Parent and os.clock()-(recent[o] or -1000)>(category=="Mailboxes" and 3600 or 180) then
   local kind=category=="Pumpkin" and rarity(o) or "Common"
   if category~="Pumpkin" or S[kind] then
    local d=(r.Position-o.Position).Magnitude
    if kind=="Legendary" then
     d=d-120
    elseif kind=="Rare" then
     d=d-30
    end
    if not score or d<score then
     best=o
     score=d
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

local function collect(o)
 local r=root()
 if not r or not o or not o.Parent then return end
 local h=humanoid()

 if h and h.Sit then
  h.Sit=false
  task.wait(0.05)
 end

 r=root()
 if not r then return end

 r.CFrame=CFrame.new(o.Position+Vector3.new(0,2.3,0))

 if type(firetouchinterest)=="function" then
  pcall(firetouchinterest,r,o,0)
  pcall(firetouchinterest,r,o,1)
 end

 for _,item in ipairs((o.Parent or o):GetDescendants()) do
  if item:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and type(fireproximityprompt)=="function" then
   pcall(fireproximityprompt,item)
  elseif item:IsA("ClickDetector") and type(fireclickdetector)=="function" then
   pcall(fireclickdetector,item)
  end
 end
end

pcall(function()
 local module=LP:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts",5):FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
 if module then
  controls=require(module):GetControls()
 end
end)

local lastForward=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)

local function flatCamera()
 local camera=W.CurrentCamera
 if camera then
  local v=camera.CFrame.LookVector
  local flat=Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)
  if flat.Magnitude>0.01 then
   lastForward=flat.Unit
  end
 end
 return lastForward,Vector3.new(-lastForward.Z,0,lastForward.X)
end

local function moveVector()
 if controls then
  local ok,v=pcall(function()
   return controls:GetMoveVector()
  end)
  if ok and typeof(v)=="Vector3" then
   return v
  end
 end

 local h=humanoid()
 local v=h and h.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
 local f,right=flatCamera()
 return Vector3.new(v:Dot(right),0,-v:Dot(f))
end

local function motion(v)
 local forward,right=flatCamera()
 local up=(pressed.Up or U:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E)
  or U:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)) and 1 or 0
 local down=(pressed.Down or U:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q)
  or U:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)) and 1 or 0
 local dir=right*v.X-forward*v.Z+Vector3.yAxis*(up-down)
 return dir.Magnitude>0.05 and dir.Unit or Vector3.zero
end

local function stopPlayer()
 if playerV then playerV:Destroy() end
 if playerG then playerG:Destroy() end
 playerV=nil
 playerG=nil

 if activePlayer and activePlayer.Parent then
  activePlayer.PlatformStand=false
  activePlayer.AutoRotate=true
 end
 activePlayer=nil
end

local function stopCar()
 if carV then carV:Destroy() end
 if carG then carG:Destroy() end
 carV=nil
 carG=nil
 activeCar=nil
end

local function stopFlight()
 stopPlayer()
 stopCar()
 pressed.Up=false
 pressed.Down=false
 if touchGui then touchGui.Enabled=false end
end

local function flightObjects(part,kind)
 if kind=="Player" then
  if not playerV or playerV.Parent~=part then
   stopPlayer()
   playerV=Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
   playerV.MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9)
   playerV.P=25000
   playerV.Parent=part

   playerG=Instance.new("BodyGyro")
   playerG.MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9)
   playerG.P=25000
   playerG.Parent=part
  end
  return playerV,playerG
 end

 if not carV or carV.Parent~=part then
  stopCar()
  carV=Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
  carV.MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9)
  carV.P=25000
  carV.Parent=part

  carG=Instance.new("BodyGyro")
  carG.MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9)
  carG.P=25000
  carG.Parent=part
 end

 return carV,carG
end

local function flyPlayer()
 local r=root()
 local h=humanoid()
 if not r or not h then return end

 local velocity,gyro=flightObjects(r,"Player")
 activePlayer=h
 h.PlatformStand=true
 h.AutoRotate=false

 velocity.Velocity=motion(moveVector())*S.FlyPlayerSpeed
 local forward=flatCamera()
 gyro.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(r.Position,r.Position+forward,Vector3.yAxis)
end

local function flyCar()
 local m,seat=vehicle()
 if not m or not seat then
  stopCar()
  return
 end

 local part=m.PrimaryPart or seat
 local velocity,gyro=flightObjects(part,"Car")
 local throttle=seat.ThrottleFloat
 local steer=seat.SteerFloat

 if U:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then throttle=1 end
 if U:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then throttle=-1 end
 if U:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then steer=1 end
 if U:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then steer=-1 end

 velocity.Velocity=motion(Vector3.new(steer,0,-throttle))*S.FlyCarSpeed
 local forward=flatCamera()
 gyro.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(part.Position,part.Position+forward,Vector3.yAxis)
end

local function carSpeed()
 local m,seat=vehicle()
 if not m or not seat then return end

 pcall(function()
  seat.MaxSpeed=S.CarSpeed
  seat.Torque=math.max(seat.Torque,S.CarSpeed*100)

  if S.CarBoost and not S.CarFly and seat.ThrottleFloat>0.1 then
   (m.PrimaryPart or seat).AssemblyLinearVelocity=seat.CFrame.LookVector*S.CarSpeed
  end
 end)
end

local function flipCar()
 local m=vehicle()
 if not m then return end
 local cf=m:GetPivot()
 if cf.UpVector.Y>=0.2 then return end

 local v=Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X,0,cf.LookVector.Z)
 if v.Magnitude<0.1 then
  v=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
 end

 local p=cf.Position+Vector3.new(0,5,0)
 m:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(p,p+v))
end

local function queueRestart()
 local queue=queue_on_teleport or queueonteleport or (syn and syn.queue_on_teleport)
 if type(queue)~="function" or type(G.DT_Source)~="string" then
  return false
 end

 local settings={}
 for k,v in pairs(S) do
  settings[k]=v
 end

 settings.Pumpkin=true
 settings.Boss=false
 settings.AutoSwap=false
 settings.FarmDelay=0.05

 local data=H:JSONEncode({
  settings=settings,
  visited=visited
 })

 local code="local G=type(getgenv)=='function' and getgenv() or _G\n"
  .."G.DT_Source="..string.format("%q",G.DT_Source).."\n"
  .."G.DT_Restore="..string.format("%q",data).."\n"
  .."loadstring(G.DT_Source)()"

 return pcall(queue,code)
end

local hopping=false

local function swapServer()
 if hopping then return end
 hopping=true
 notify("Searching for a low-population server...")

 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,err=pcall(function()
   local req=(syn and syn.request) or http_request or request

   local function fetch(url)
    local raw
    if type(req)=="function" then
     local res=req({Url=url,Method="GET"})
     if not res or not res.Body then
      error("Server list unavailable")
     end
     raw=res.Body
    else
     raw=game:HttpGet(url)
    end
    return H:JSONDecode(raw)
   end

   local seen={}
   for _,id in ipairs(visited) do
    seen[id]=true
   end

   local best,count,cursor

   for _=1,4 do
    local url="https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"..game.PlaceId.."/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=50"

    if cursor then
     url=url.."&cursor="..H:UrlEncode(cursor)
    end

    local data=fetch(url)

    for _,server in ipairs(data.data or {}) do
     local n=tonumber(server.playing)
     local max=tonumber(server.maxPlayers)

     if n and max and n>=1 and n<max and server.id~=game.JobId
      and not seen[server.id] and (not count or n<count) then
      best=server.id
      count=n
     end
    end

    cursor=data.nextPageCursor
    if not cursor or count==1 then break end
   end

   if not best then
    error("No available server found")
   end

   table.insert(visited,best)

   if not queueRestart() then
    error("Automatic restart not supported by Delta")
   end

   notify("Switching server | Players: "..count)
   T:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId,best,LP)
  end)

  if not ok then
   notify("Server swap failed: "..tostring(err))
  end

  hopping=false
 end)
end

local function guiScale(v)
 local parents={
  game:GetService("CoreGui"),
  LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
 }

 if type(gethui)=="function" then
  local ok,x=pcall(gethui)
  if ok and x then table.insert(parents,1,x) end
 end

 for _,p in ipairs(parents) do
  if p then
   for _,screen in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
    if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and (
     screen.Name:lower():find("rayfield",1,true)
     or screen.Name:lower():find("double tap",1,true)
    ) then
     local frame=screen:FindFirstChild("Main",true)
      or screen:FindFirstChild("MainFrame",true)

     if not frame then
      for _,c in ipairs(screen:GetChildren()) do
       if c:IsA("Frame") and c.AbsoluteSize.X>200 then
        frame=c
        break
       end
      end
     end

     if frame and frame:IsA("GuiObject") then
      local scale=frame:FindFirstChild("DoubleTapScale")
       or Instance.new("UIScale")
      scale.Name="DoubleTapScale"
      scale.Parent=frame
      scale.Scale=v
      return
     end

local wallNames = {"WeakWall", "WeakWalls", "WeakGlass", "WeakStaticWall", "WeakRustyWall", "FakeWall", "FakeSmile", "UncollideWall", "WeakWraithWall"}
local wallsEnabled = false
local wallsCount = 0
local lastWallScan = 0

local function clearWalls()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastWallScan < 2 then return end
    lastWallScan = now
    
    local count = 0
    
    local function scanAndDestroy(parent)
        for _, obj in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Model") then
                local shouldDestroy = false
                for _, name in ipairs(wallNames) do
                    if obj.Name == name then
                        shouldDestroy = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if obj.Name == "WeakWraithWall7" then
                    shouldDestroy = true
                end
                if shouldDestroy then
                    pcall(function() obj:Destroy(); count += 1 end)
                elseif obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("Folder") then
                    scanAndDestroy(obj)
                end
            elseif obj:IsA("Folder") then
                scanAndDestroy(obj)
            end
        end
    end
    
    scanAndDestroy(workspace)
    wallsCount += count
    return count
end

local function wallsLoop()
    while wallsEnabled do
        clearWalls()
        task.wait(2)
    end
end

-- ============================================
-- EXIT FINDER
-- ============================================
local function findExit(findAlternate)
    local exitNames = {"Exit", "ExitDoor", "ExitPortal", "Finish", "FinishLine", "Win", "WinPad", "End", "Goal"}
    local blacklist = {"VendingMachine", "VendingMachineButton", "Lobby", "Spawn"}
    local result = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            local blacklisted = false
            for _, b in ipairs(blacklist) do
                if obj.Name:find(b) or (obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name:find(b)) then blacklisted = true; break end
            end
            if blacklisted then continue end
            local isAlt = false
            local p = obj.Parent
            while p do
                if p.Name:lower():gsub("%s+",""):find("alternate") and p.Name:lower():find("exit") then isAlt = true; break end
                p = p.Parent
            end
            local matched = false
            for _, n in ipairs(exitNames) do if obj.Name == n then matched = true; break end end
            if not matched then
                local ln = obj.Name:lower()
                if ln:find("exit") or ln:find("finish") or ln:find("goal") or ln:find("win") or ln:find("end") then matched = true end
            end
            if matched and isAlt == findAlternate then table.insert(result, obj) end
        end
    end
    return result
end

local function tpToObj(found, label, btn)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then statusLabel.Text = "No character!"; return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then statusLabel.Text = "No root!"; return end
    if not found then
        statusLabel.Text = label .. " not found!"
        btn.Text = "NOT FOUND"
        task.wait(1.5)
        btn.Text = label == "Exit" and "TELEPORT TO EXIT" or "TP TO ALTERNATE EXIT"
        return
    end
    local tp = found.Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
    local ray = workspace:Raycast(found.Position, Vector3.new(0,10,0), RaycastParams.new())
    if ray then tp = ray.Position - Vector3.new(0,2,0) end
    tp += found.CFrame.LookVector * 3
    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(tp)
    statusLabel.Text = "TP to: " .. found.Name
    btn.Text = "TP: " .. found.Name
    task.wait(1.5)
    btn.Text = label == "Exit" and "TELEPORT TO EXIT" or "TP TO ALTERNATE EXIT"
end

tpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local exits = findExit(false)
    tpToObj(#exits > 0 and exits[1] or nil, "Exit", tpButton)
end)

tpAltButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local exits = findExit(true)

end)

-- ============================================
local espWraithEnabled = false
local espWraithConnection
local espHighlights = {}
local originalProperties = {}

local function highlightGate(obj)
    if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if obj.Name ~= "WraithGate" then return end
    if obj.Transparency <= 0.5 then return end
    if espHighlights[obj] then return end
    
    originalProperties[obj] = obj.Transparency
    obj.Transparency = 0.3
    
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.FillColor = obj.Color
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.3
    highlight.Enabled = true
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
    highlight.Parent = obj
    espHighlights[obj] = highlight
end

local function onDescendantAdded(obj)
    if espWraithEnabled then
        highlightGate(obj)
    end
end

local function clearAllHighlights()
    for obj, highlight in pairs(espHighlights) do
        if originalProperties[obj] then
            pcall(function() obj.Transparency = originalProperties[obj] end)
            originalProperties[obj] = nil
        end
        highlight:Destroy()
    end
    espHighlights = {}
end

local function isVisible(playerPos, targetPart)
    local targetPos = targetPart.Position

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

    local now = tick()
    if now - lastClickScan < 0.2 then return end
    lastClickScan = now
    
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local playerPos = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position

    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("ClickDetector") then
            local part = descendant.Parent
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local distance = (playerPos - part.Position).Magnitude
                if distance <= 10 then
                    if isVisible(playerPos, part) then
                        pcall(function()
                            fireclickdetector(descendant, distance)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local currentKey = nil

local function setupCharacter(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://72722244508749"
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)

    screenGui:ClearAllChildren()

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = screenGui
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true

    local playBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    playBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    playBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    playBtn.Text = "Play Animation"
    playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 180)
    playBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    playBtn.Parent = frame

    playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        animTrack:Play()
    end)

    local keybindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    keybindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
    keybindBtn.Text = currentKey and ("Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")") or "Set Keybind (Current: none)"
    keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 150)
    keybindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    keybindBtn.TextScaled = true
    keybindBtn.Parent = frame

    local waitingForKey = false

    keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        keybindBtn.Text = "Press a key..."
        waitingForKey = true
    end)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if waitingForKey and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            currentKey = input.KeyCode
            keybindBtn.Text = "Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")"
            waitingForKey = false
        elseif currentKey and input.KeyCode == currentKey and not gameProcessed then
            animTrack:Play()
        end
    end)
end

if player.Character then
    setupCharacter(player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    setupCharacter(char)
end)

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

        end
        for i = 1, Amount do

            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

end)

                    table.remove(cashRegisters, i)
                end
            end
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then

        end

end)

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
                if openFlag and openFlag.Value then
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                else
                    local openSafe = item:FindFirstChild("OpenSafe")
                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)

    end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end

     end
     return Files
    end

        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            From = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            To = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateLine = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             local from = self.From
             local to = self.To
             local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
             local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y - from.Y, to.X - from.X))

             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, self.Thickness)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, from.X, 0, from.Y)
             a.Rotation = angle
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Size = UDim2.new(0, (self.To - self.From).Magnitude, 0, value)
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' and value <= 1 then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'From' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            elseif key == 'To' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            end
        end

        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1

               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy()

             if not b or not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Radius, 0, self.Radius)

             b.Enabled = not self

            for i, v in getsenv(Script) do
                if type(v) == "table" then
                    if #v == 0 then
                        if type(i) == "number" then
                            Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal table_%d = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(pKey1(i, v))
                        else
                            Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal %s = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(i)
                        end
                    else
                        if type(i) == "number" then
                            Decompiled =
                                Decompiled ..
                                ("local table_%d = {\n%s};"):format(
                                    pKey1(i, v),
                                    processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i))
                                )
                        else
                            Decompiled =
                                Decompiled ..
                                ("local %s = {\n%s};\n"):format(i, processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i)))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for i, v in gcsenv(Script) do -- garbage collection senv
                local name = debug.getinfo(v).name
                if name == nil and Settings.IncludeNils then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0, "nil" .. tostring(uks)))
                    uks = uks + 1
                elseif name ~= nil then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0))
                end
            end
        end
    )
    if not s then
        return " --An error occured while attempting to iterate over Script's enviroment!\nMessage: " .. e
    end
    return Decompiled
end

getgenv().decompile = DecompileScript

    local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
    
    local blockSize = tonumber(SizeBox.Text) or 1
    local distance = tonumber(DistBox.Text) or 5
    
    local rootPos = hrp.Position
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(rootPos, Vector3.new(0, -20, 0), raycastParams)
    local floorY = raycastResult and raycastResult.Position.Y or (rootPos.Y - 3)
    
    local flatLook = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Unit.Z).Unit
    local flatRight = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.RightVector.Unit.Z).Unit
    
    local spawnPos = rootPos
    local targetLook = flatLook
    
    -- 1: Forward, 2: Backward, 3: Left, 4: Right
    if selectedDirectionIndex == 1 then
        spawnPos = rootPos + flatLook * distance
        targetLook = -flatLook
    elseif selectedDirectionIndex == 2 then
        spawnPos = rootPos - flatLook * distance
        targetLook = flatLook
    elseif selectedDirectionIndex == 3 then
        spawnPos = rootPos - flatRight * distance
        targetLook = flatRight
    elseif selectedDirectionIndex == 4 then
        spawnPos = rootPos + flatRight * distance
        targetLook = -flatRight
    end
    
    spawnPos = Vector3.new(spawnPos.X, floorY, spawnPos.Z)
    local spawnCF = CFrame.new(spawnPos, spawnPos + targetLook)
    
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "UserDrawing_" .. tostring(tick())
    folder.Parent = workspace
    table.insert(spawnedDrawings, folder)
    
    local depth = isVolumetric and 3 or 1
    
    for x = 1, gridSize do
        for y = 1, gridSize do
            local col = gridData[x][y]
            if col ~= Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50) then
                for z = 0, depth - 1 do
                    local part = Instance.new("Part")
                    part.Size = Vector3.new(blockSize, blockSize, blockSize)
                    part.Color = col
                    part.Anchored = true
                    part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    
                    local xOffset = (x - gridSize / 2 - 0.5) * blockSize
                    local yOffset = ((gridSize - y) * blockSize) + (blockSize / 2)
                    local zOffset = z * blockSize
                    
                    part.CFrame = spawnCF * CFrame.new(xOffset, yOffset, zOffset)
                    part.Parent = folder
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Поддерживает мобильные экзекуторы (Fluxus, Delta, Hydrogen и др.)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- СОЗДАНИЕ ПЛАТФОРМЫ
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function CreateSafePlatform(position)
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "SafeZone_Platform_Container"

    local floor = Instance.new("Part")
    floor.Size = Vector3.new(40, 2, 40)
    floor.Position = position
    floor.Anchored = true
    floor.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 40)
    floor.Parent = folder

    local wallData = {
        {pos = Vector3.new(0, 10, 20), size = Vector3.new(40, 20, 1)},
        {pos = Vector3.new(0, 10, -20), size = Vector3.new(40, 20, 1)},
        {pos = Vector3.new(20, 10, 0), size = Vector3.new(1, 20, 40)},
        {pos = Vector3.new(-20, 10, 0), size = Vector3.new(1, 20, 40)}
    }

    for _, data in ipairs(wallData) do
        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Size = data.size
        wall.Position = position + data.pos
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
        wall.Transparency = 0.5
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 180, 255)
        wall.Parent = folder
    end

    folder.Parent = workspace
    return folder, position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
end

local ToggleBtn

    if ToggleBtn then
        if Settings.Enabled then
            ToggleBtn.Text = "1 нажатие: включить, 2: выключить (ВКЛ) / 1 click: ON, 2: OFF"

end

local function TeleportToSafeZone()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    if not State.InSafeZone then
        State.SavedCFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        
        local safePos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, SAFE_ZONE_HEIGHT, 0)
        local platFolder, spawnCFrame = CreateSafePlatform(safePos)
        State.SafePlatform = platFolder
        
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnCFrame)
        State.InSafeZone = true
        
        Settings.Enabled = false
        UpdateToggleVisual()
    end
end

local function ReturnFromSafeZone()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    if State.InSafeZone and State.SavedCFrame then
        local targetCFrame = State.SavedCFrame
        local dist = Settings.OffsetDistance
        
        if Settings.OffsetDirection == "Вперед" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist)
        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Назад" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, dist)
        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Вправо" then

        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Влево" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(-dist, 0, 0)
        end
        
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetCFrame
        
        if State.SafePlatform then

            State.SafePlatform = nil
        end
        State.InSafeZone = false
    end
