-- [[ Slap Battles Macro]] --
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local FileName = "MacroGloveConfig.json"

-- [[ DEFAULT SETTINGS ]] --
local Settings = {
    Enabled = false,
    BotType = "Closest", 
    IgnoreRagdoll = false,
    SlapRadius = 10,
    Shiftlock = false,
    ShiftlockRadius = 20,
    Jumps = false,
    JumpChance = 10,
    IgnoreOneshots = false,
    DistanceRadius = 5,
    StrafeEnabled = false,
    StrafeRadius = 15,    
    UnequipFar = false,
    UnequipRadius = 30,
    DangerMode = false,
    DangerType = "Backoff", 
    DangerHP = 40,
    AutoAbility = false,
    AbilityMode = "Combat", 
    
    ServerHopMode = "Main",
    MinPlayers = 0,
    IgnoreLowPlayers = false,
    AutoHopTimerEnabled = false,
    AutoHopMinutes = 30,
    HopOnOneshotsEnabled = false,
    MaxOneshotsAllowed = 1,
    LastHopTick = tick(),
    AutoTournament = false 
}

-- [[ DATA TRACKING ]] --
local LastSlapCount = 0
local LastReachedTime = tick() 
local LastClickTick = 0

local function GetSlaps()
    local stats = Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    local slaps = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Slaps")
    return slaps and slaps.Value or 0
end
LastSlapCount = GetSlaps()

-- [[ SAVE / LOAD LOGIC ]] --
local function SaveSettings()
    local success, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(Settings) end)
    if success then writefile(FileName, encoded) end
end

local function LoadSettings()
    if isfile(FileName) then
        local success, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FileName)) end)
        if success then
            for k, v in pairs(decoded) do
                Settings[k] = v
            end
        end
    end
end
LoadSettings()

local GameIDs = { Main = 6403373529, NoOneshots = 9015014224, KS = 11520107397 }
local OneShotGloves = {"OVERKILL", "God's Hand", "The Flex", "Error", "rob", "Shopkeeper", "Spectator", "buddies"}

-- [[ CORE FUNCTIONS ]] --
local function ServerHop()
    SaveSettings()
    local targetID = GameIDs[Settings.ServerHopMode] or GameIDs.Main
    TeleportService:Teleport(targetID, Player)
end

local function TriggerAbility()
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then return end
    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
    task.wait(0.05)
    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
end

local function MoveToTargetSmooth(targetPos)
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not hum then return end

    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({AgentRadius = 3, AgentCanJump = true})
    path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, targetPos)
    if path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
        if waypoints[2] then
            hum:MoveTo(waypoints[2].Position)
            if waypoints[2].Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then hum.Jump = true end
        end
    else
        hum:MoveTo(targetPos)
    end
end

local function GetTarget()
    local pot = {}
    local char = Player.Character
    local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= Player and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local c = p.Character
            local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local tRoot = c.HumanoidRootPart
            
            local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
            rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c, Player.Character}
            local floorCheck = workspace:Raycast(tRoot.Position, Vector3.new(0, -15, 0), rayParams)

            local isOneshots = false
            for _, g in pairs(OneShotGloves) do if c:FindFirstChild(g) or p.Backpack:FindFirstChild(g) then isOneshots = true break end end
            
            if h and h.Health > 0 and not c:FindFirstChild("rock") and (not Settings.IgnoreOneshots or not isOneshots) then
                if math.abs(myRoot.Position.Y - tRoot.Position.Y) < 12 and floorCheck then
                    if not (Settings.IgnoreRagdoll and c:FindFirstChild("Ragdolled") and c.Ragdolled.Value) then
                        table.insert(pot, p)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #pot == 0 then return nil end
    if Settings.BotType == "Closest" then table.sort(pot, function(a,b) return Player:DistanceFromCharacter(a.Character.PrimaryPart.Position) < Player:DistanceFromCharacter(b.Character.PrimaryPart.Position) end)
    elseif Settings.BotType == "Furthest" then table.sort(pot, function(a,b) return Player:DistanceFromCharacter(a.Character.PrimaryPart.Position) > Player:DistanceFromCharacter(b.Character.PrimaryPart.Position) end) end
    return Settings.BotType == "Random" and pot[math.random(1,#pot)] or pot[1]
end

-- [[ TOURNAMENT CLICKER ]] --
local function HandleTournamentGUI()
    if tick() - LastClickTick < 1 then return end 

    for _, gui in pairs(PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if gui.Name == "Component" then
            local container = gui:FindFirstChild("SlapTournament")
            if container and container.Visible then
                local targetButton = Settings.AutoTournament and container:FindFirstChild("AcceptButton") or container:FindFirstChild("DeclineButton")
                
                if targetButton and targetButton.Visible then
                    -- Get center of button
                    local absPos = targetButton.AbsolutePosition
                    local absSize = targetButton.AbsoluteSize
                    -- Offset for the Roblox TopBar (approx 36-58 pixels)
                    local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
                    local centerX = absPos.X + (absSize.X / 2) + inset.X
                    local centerY = absPos.Y + (absSize.Y / 2) + inset.Y

                    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(centerX, centerY, 0, true, game, 0)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(centerX, centerY, 0, false, game, 0)
                    
                    LastClickTick = tick()
                    warn("Tournament Button Clicked at: " .. tostring(centerX) .. ", " .. tostring(centerY))
                end
            end
        end
    end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    HandleTournamentGUI() 

    if not Settings.Enabled then 
        LastReachedTime = tick() 
        return 
    end
    
    local char = Player.Character; local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not hum then return end
    
    local toolInChar = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    local toolInBackpack = Player.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    
    -- TOURNAMENT SAFETY CHECK
    local tourneyOpen = false
    for _, gui in pairs(PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if gui.Name == "Component" and gui:FindFirstChild("SlapTournament") and gui.SlapTournament.Visible then
            tourneyOpen = true break
        end
    end

    if not toolInChar and not toolInBackpack then
        if tourneyOpen and Settings.AutoTournament then 
            hum:Move(Vector3.new(0,0,0))
            return 
        end
        
        local teleport = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") and workspace.Lobby:FindFirstChild("Teleport1")
        if teleport then MoveToTargetSmooth(teleport.Position) end
        LastReachedTime = tick() 
        return
    end
    
    if Settings.Jumps and math.random(1, 100) <= Settings.JumpChance then hum.Jump = true end

    local target = GetTarget()
    if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local tRoot = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        local dist = (root.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude
        
        if dist <= (Settings.SlapRadius + 5) then LastReachedTime = tick() end
        if tick() - LastReachedTime > 45 then
            LastReachedTime = tick()
            hum.Health = 0
            return
        end
        
        if Settings.Shiftlock and dist <= Settings.ShiftlockRadius then 
            root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, Vector3.new(tRoot.Position.X, root.Position.Y, tRoot.Position.Z)) 
        end
        
        if Settings.UnequipFar then
            if dist > Settings.UnequipRadius then hum:UnequipTools()
            elseif dist <= Settings.UnequipRadius and toolInBackpack then hum:EquipTool(toolInBackpack) end
        elseif toolInBackpack then hum:EquipTool(toolInBackpack) end

        if Settings.StrafeEnabled and dist <= Settings.StrafeRadius then
            local speed = 4 
            local time = tick() * speed
            local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(time) * Settings.DistanceRadius, 0, math.sin(time) * Settings.DistanceRadius)
            MoveToTargetSmooth(tRoot.Position + offset)
        elseif dist > Settings.DistanceRadius then
            MoveToTargetSmooth(tRoot.Position)
        end

        if dist <= Settings.SlapRadius and toolInChar then toolInChar:Activate() end
    else
        LastReachedTime = tick()
    end
end)

-- [[ ABILITY ENGINE LOOP ]] --
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.1)
        if not Settings.Enabled or not Settings.AutoAbility then continue end
        local char = Player.Character
        local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if not tool then continue end
        local target = GetTarget()
        local dist = 999
        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            dist = (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
        end

        if Settings.AbilityMode == "Combat" then
            if dist <= 15 then TriggerAbility(); task.wait(1) end
        elseif Settings.AbilityMode == "Defensive" then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if (dist > 15 and dist < 30) or (hum and hum.Health < Settings.DangerHP) then
                TriggerAbility(); task.wait(1)
            end
        elseif Settings.AbilityMode == "Instant" then
            TriggerAbility()
            task.wait(0.5)
        elseif Settings.AbilityMode == "Combo" then
            local currentSlaps = GetSlaps()
            if currentSlaps > LastSlapCount then
                task.wait(0.5)
                TriggerAbility()
                LastSlapCount = currentSlaps
            end
        elseif Settings.AbilityMode == "Camping" then
            if dist > 50 then TriggerAbility(); task.wait(1) end
        end
        LastSlapCount = GetSlaps()
    end
end)

-- Автоматическое скрытие блоков (игнорируя всех игроков) во время прицеливания
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    clearHiddenParts()
    if not isZoomed then return end

    local hideCount = tonumber(hideBlocksBox.Text)
    if not hideCount or hideCount <= 0 then return end

    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 100000

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    
    local ignoreList = {screenGui}
    if player.Character then
        table.insert(ignoreList, player.Character)
    end

    local hiddenCountFound = 0
    local maxIterations = 20
    local iter = 0

    while hiddenCountFound < hideCount and iter < maxIterations do
        iter = iter + 1
        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
        local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
        if not result or not result.Instance then break end

        local hitPart = result.Instance

        -- Проверяем, принадлежит ли найденная деталь какому-либо игроку
        local isPlayer = false
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character and hitPart:IsDescendantOf(p.Character) then
                isPlayer = true
                break
            end
        end

        if isPlayer then
            -- Если это игрок, просто пропускаем его и продолжаем луч дальше
            table.insert(ignoreList, hitPart)
            origin = result.Position + (camera.CFrame.LookVector * 0.1)
        else
            if hitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
                if not hiddenParts[hitPart] then
                    hiddenParts[hitPart] = hitPart.Transparency
                end
                hitPart.Transparency = 1
                table.insert(ignoreList, hitPart)
                origin = result.Position + (camera.CFrame.LookVector * 0.1)
                hiddenCountFound = hiddenCountFound + 1
            else
                break
            end
        end
    end
end)

    local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")

    local frame = cg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    if not frame or not frame.Visible then return nil end

local function chestButton(cg, name)
    local frame = cg and cg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    local bottom = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("BottomBar")
    local choices = bottom and bottom:FindFirstChild("Choices")
    local btn = choices and choices:FindFirstChild(name)
    return btn and btn:FindFirstChild("Click") or nil
end

local function pressLootAll(cg)
    local click = chestButton(cg, "LootAllBtn")
    if not click then return false end
    local fired = false
    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(click.Activated)) do
        local ok = pcall(function() c.Function() end)
        if ok then fired = true end
    end
    return fired
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ESP helper
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function hpColour(pct)
    local r = 214 + (84 - 214) * pct
    local g = 72 + (200 - 72) * pct
    local b = 72 + (130 - 72) * pct
    return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(r), math.floor(g), math.floor(b))
end

local function addESP(model, name, colour)
    if not model or not model.Parent then return end
    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head then return end

    -- a stale billboard from an older panel build has no HP child - rebuild it
    local existing = head:FindFirstChild("OW_ESP")
    if existing then
        if existing:FindFirstChild("HP") then return end
        pcall(function() existing:Destroy() end)
    end

    local billboard = new("BillboardGui", {
        Name = "OW_ESP",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 36),
        StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0),
        AlwaysOnTop = true,
        MaxDistance = 900,
    }, head)

    new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 11,
        TextColor3 = colour,
        TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3,
        Text = name,
    }, billboard)

    local hpLabel = new("TextLabel", {
        Name = "HP",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 15),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.Code,
        TextSize = 10,
        TextColor3 = C.text,
        TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3,
        Text = "- / -",
    }, billboard)

    local bar = new("Frame", {
        Name = "Bar",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 4),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -60, 0, 30),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 27),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, billboard)
    corner(bar, 2)

    local fill = new("Frame", {
        Name = "Fill",
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.good,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, bar)
    corner(fill, 2)

    table.insert(ENV.espObjects, billboard)
    ENV.espMap[billboard] = model
    return billboard, hpLabel, fill
end

local function refreshESP()
    for billboard, model in pairs(ENV.espMap) do
        if not model or not model.Parent then
            pcall(function() billboard:Destroy() end)
            ENV.espMap[billboard] = nil
        else
            local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hpLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("HP")
            local bar = billboard:FindFirstChild("Bar")
            local fill = bar and bar:FindFirstChild("Fill")
            if hum and hpLabel then
                local max = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
                local pct = math.clamp(hum.Health / max, 0, 1)
                hpLabel.Text = string.format("%d / %d", math.floor(hum.Health + 0.5), math.floor(hum.MaxHealth + 0.5))
                hpLabel.TextColor3 = hpColour(pct)
                if fill then
                    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(pct, 1)
                    fill.BackgroundColor3 = hpColour(pct)
                end
            elseif hpLabel then
                hpLabel.Text = "- / -"
                hpLabel.TextColor3 = C.faint
                if fill then fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) end
            end
        end
    end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- loop
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function nearestDemon(myPos, myChar)
    local alive = workspace:FindFirstChild("Alive")
    if not alive then return nil end
    local best, bd = nil, 1e9
    for _, m in ipairs(alive:GetChildren()) do
        if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= myChar then
            local ok, h = pcall(function() return m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end)
            local ok2, r = pcall(function() return m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end)
            if ok and ok2 and h and r and r.Parent and h.Health > 0 then
                local ok3, d = pcall(function() return (r.Position - myPos).Magnitude end)
                if ok3 and d < bd then bd = d best = m end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function input()
    return NET and NET:FindFirstChild("Input") or nil
end

-- One swing path for every source. The interval is a gate, not a feature of
-- auto swing: manual taps and the auto loop both go through here, so the
-- slider keeps working with auto swing off.
local function requestSwing()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - ENV.lastSwing < ENV.swingInterval then return false end
    local inp = input()
    if not inp then return false end
    ENV.lastSwing = now
    ENV.parryUntil = now + ENV.swingInterval + 0.05
    pcall(function()
        inp:FireServer("LeftClick", { Uppercut = false, Air = false, Space = false })
    end)
    ENV.swings = ENV.swings + 1
    return true
end

ENV.requestSwing = requestSwing

local function loop()
    if not ENV.alive then return end
    local ch = character()
    local hum = humanoid()
    local myRoot = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local now = os.clock()

    if ENV.reachLock and myRoot then
        local target = nearestDemon(myRoot.Position, ch)
        ENV.lockTarget = target
        if target then
            local tr = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if tr then
                -- stand on the side the target is not looking at, at the same
                -- distance, and face them so the swing still connects
                local back = tr.CFrame.LookVector
                local pos = tr.Position - back * ENV.lockOffset.Z
                    + Vector3.new(0, ENV.lockOffset.Y, 0)
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, tr.Position)
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.autoSwing and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        requestSwing()
    end

    if ENV.purgeDebuffs then
        local st = state()
        if st then
            for _, name in ipairs(DEBUFFS) do
                if st:Has(name) then pcall(function() st:Remove(name) end) end
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.purgeCooldowns then
        local st = state()
        if st then pcall(function() st:ClearCooldown() end) end
    end

    if ENV.slowImmune and ch and ch:GetAttribute("SlowImmune") ~= true then
        ch:SetAttribute("SlowImmune", true)
    end

    if ENV.noclip and ch then
        for _, part in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
        end
    end

    if ENV.sustain and hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum.Health < hum.MaxHealth then
        hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
    end

    if ENV.lootAll then
        local cg = chestGui()
        if not cg then
            ENV.lootSeen = nil
            ENV.lootCount = 0
        else
            if ENV.lootSeen ~= cg then
                ENV.lootSeen = cg
                ENV.lootAt = now
                ENV.lootCount = 0
            end
            -- the button refuses a press until its charge finished, so hold off
            -- for LOOT_CHARGE and then re-press while the chest is still open
            if ENV.lootCount < 8
                and now - (ENV.lootAt or 0) > LOOT_CHARGE
                and now - (ENV.lastLoot or 0) > 1.4 then
                ENV.lastLoot = now
                if pressLootAll(cg) then ENV.lootCount = ENV.lootCount + 1 end
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.holdBlock and now - ENV.lastBlock > 0.8 then
        ENV.lastBlock = now
        local inp = input()
        if inp then pcall(function() inp:FireServer("Block", true) end) end
    end

    if ENV.autoParry and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        local inp = input()
        if inp then
            if now < ENV.parryUntil then
                pcall(function() inp:FireServer("Block", true) end)
            elseif ENV.parryUntil > 0 then
                pcall(function() inp:FireServer("Block", false) end)
                ENV.parryUntil = 0
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.autoBreathe and hum and hum.Health > 0 and now - ENV.lastBreathe > 1 then
        local inp = input()
        local st = state()
        if inp and ch then
            local b = ch:GetAttribute("Breath")
            local maxb = ch:GetAttribute("MaxBreath") or 100
            local allowed = b ~= nil and b < maxb and not (st and st:Has("Breathing"))
            if allowed then
                pcall(function() inp:FireServer("Breathe", true) end)
                ENV.lastBreathe = now
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.espPlayers or ENV.espDemons then
        -- 10 Hz is plenty for a health readout and keeps the frame cheap
        if now - (ENV.lastESP or 0) > 0.1 then
            ENV.lastESP = now
            refreshESP()
        end
    end

    if ENV.espPlayers then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                addESP(p.Character, p.Name, C.accent)
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.espDemons then
        local alive = workspace:FindFirstChild("Alive")
        if alive then
            for _, m in ipairs(alive:GetChildren()) do
                if m:IsA("Model") and not m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Player") then
                    addESP(m, m.Name, Color3.fromRGB(232, 176, 72))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

ENV.conns[#ENV.conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    pcall(loop)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- readouts
------------------------------------------------------------------------
task.spawn(function()
    while ENV.alive do
        task.wait(0.35)
        pcall(function()
            for key, label in pairs(statLabels) do
                local v = LP:GetAttribute(key)
                label.Text = key .. "  " .. (v ~= nil and tostring(v) or "-")

            local hum = humanoid()

            charLabel.Text = hum and ("hp  " .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. " / " .. math.floor(hum.MaxHealth)) or "hp  -"
            wsLabel.Text = hum and ("walkspeed  " .. math.floor(hum.WalkSpeed) .. "   tag +" .. ENV.speedValue) or "walkspeed  -"

            if ch and STATE_OK then
                local st = state()
                if st then
                    local n, names = 0, {}
                    for _, t in pairs(st.Tags) do
                        n = n + 1
                        if n <= 5 then names[#names + 1] = t.Name end
                    end
                    tagLabel.Text = "tags  " .. n .. "   " .. (#names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "none")
                end
            end

            statusLabel.Text = ENV.alive and "live" or "off"
            liveDot.BackgroundColor3 = ENV.alive and C.good or C.faint

            local cg = chestGui()
            chestStatus.Text = cg
                and ("chest  open    looted " .. ENV.lootCount)
                or "chest  closed"
            chestStatus.TextColor3 = cg and C.good or C.faint

            local t = ENV.lockTarget
            if t and t.Parent then
                local tr = t:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local th = t:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local myRoot = root()
                local d = (tr and myRoot) and math.floor((tr.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude) or -1
                footTarget.Text = "target  " .. t.Name:sub(1, 16) .. "   d=" .. d .. "   hp=" .. (th and math.floor(th.Health) or -1)
                footTarget.TextColor3 = C.good
            else
                footTarget.Text = "target  -"
                footTarget.TextColor3 = C.dim
            end
            footSwing.Text = "swings  " .. tostring(ENV.swings)
        end)
    end
end)

for n, b in pairs(tabButtons) do
    local on = (n == "MOVEMENT")
    pages[n].Visible = on
    b.TextColor3 = on and C.text or C.dim
    b.BackgroundColor3 = on and C.raised or C.surface
    tabAccents[n].Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, on and 18 or 0)
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ENV.alive = false
    for _, c in ipairs(ENV.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    gui:Destroy()
    getgenv().OW_PANEL = nil
end)

-- true when the cursor sits over the panel, so a click on a toggle is never
-- also a swing
local function overPanel()
    if not (gui and gui.Enabled and main) then return false end
    local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local p, s = main.AbsolutePosition, main.AbsoluteSize
    return m.X >= p.X and m.X <= p.X + s.X and m.Y >= p.Y and m.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        if gui then gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled end
        return
    end

    -- manual swings go through the same gate as auto swing, so the interval
    -- slider still applies when auto swing is off
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and ENV.manualGate and ENV.reachLock and not overPanel() then
        requestSwing()
    end
end)

scripts.title: AIMBOT (MOBILE+PC)
scripts.author: ScriptBoss
scripts.summary: THIS SCRIPT KS CREATED BY BOSSSCRIPTS IT INCLUDES AIMBOT WITH MANY FEATURES AND ALSO ESP WITH MANY FEATURES (NO KEY)🔑
scripts.code:
-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]
-- This script is not verified by rscripts.net. Deal with caution.
--
-- Stay safe:
--   • Never log in on unofficial Roblox sites or lookalike domains.
--   • Real Roblox links use roblox.com (check the .com ending).
--   • Treat fake Roblox login / "claim reward" pages as phishing.
-- [[ End Rscripts Risk Notice ]]


-- BOSS SCRIPTS v1.7
-- Complete combined LocalScript
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- Designed for your own Roblox experience

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local purple = Color3.fromRGB(137,83,245)
local black = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,10)
local panel = Color3.fromRGB(22,22,22)
local white = Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245)
local gray = Color3.fromRGB(155,155,155)

local settings = {
    Aimbot = false,
    TargetMode = "Nearest",
    TargetPart = "Head",
    POVSize = 150,
    Smoothness = 8,
    TeamCheck = false,
    WallCheck = false,
    POVVisibility = 100,

    ESPEnabled = false,
    ShowNames = true,
    ShowDistance = true,
    ShowHealth = true,
    BoxESP = false,
    HighlightESP = false,
    ESPTeamCheck = false,
    ESPWallCheck = false,
    ESPColor = "White"
}

local espColors = {
    White = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
    Red = Color3.fromRGB(255,65,65),
    Green = Color3.fromRGB(65,255,100),
    Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255,230,65),
    Blue = Color3.fromRGB(65,150,255)
}

-- GUI

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BossScripts"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 20
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function corner(obj,radius)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,radius)
    c.Parent = obj
end

local function outline(obj)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(48,48,48)
    s.Parent = obj
end

local function label(parent,text,size,height)
    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    l.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,height or 30)
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.Text = text
    l.TextColor3 = white
    l.TextSize = size or 18
    l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    l.Parent = parent
    return l
end

-- MAIN WINDOW

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "MainWindow"
main.Size = UDim2.new(0.94,0,0.86,0)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.03,0,0.07,0)
main.BackgroundColor3 = black
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = gui

corner(main,9)
outline(main)

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,48)
header.BackgroundColor3 = black
header.Parent = main

label(header,"  Boss Scripts",25,48)

-- SEARCH

local searchFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
searchFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,56)
searchFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,40)
searchFrame.BackgroundColor3 = panel
searchFrame.Parent = main
corner(searchFrame,6)

local search = Instance.new("TextBox")
search.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0)
search.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,0)
search.BackgroundTransparency = 1
search.PlaceholderText = "Search..."
search.PlaceholderColor3 = gray
search.Text = ""
search.TextColor3 = white
search.Font = Enum.Font.Code
search.TextSize = 17
search.ClearTextOnFocus = false
search.Parent = searchFrame

-- TABS

local tabFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
tabFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,105)
tabFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,42)
tabFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
tabFrame.Parent = main

local tabLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
tabLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
tabLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
tabLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0,7)
tabLayout.Parent = tabFrame

local tabs = {"Aimbot","ESP","Credits"}
local tabButtons = {}

-- CONTENT

local content = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
content.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,155)
content.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-167)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.BorderSizePixel = 0
content.ScrollBarThickness = 3
content.ScrollBarImageColor3 = purple
content.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
content.Parent = main

local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.49,-5,0,450)
grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0,10,0,10)
grid.Parent = content

-- SECTIONS

local function section(name)
    local box = Instance.new("Frame")
    box.Name = name
    box.BackgroundColor3 = panel
    box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    box.Parent = content

    corner(box,8)
    outline(box)

    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0,5)
    list.Parent = box

    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,9)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,10)
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,10)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,10)
    pad.Parent = box

    label(box,name,21,37)

    local line = Instance.new("Frame")
    line.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,1)
    line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48,48,48)
    line.BorderSizePixel = 0
    line.Parent = box

    return box
end

-- TOGGLES

local function toggle(parent,name,default,callback)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Name = name
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,39)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Parent = parent

    label(row,name,16,39)

    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0,43,0,24)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(1,-43,0,7)
    button.Text = ""
    button.BackgroundColor3 = default and purple
        or Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45)
    button.Parent = row
    corner(button,15)

    local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    dot.Size = UDim2.new(0,18,0,18)
    dot.Position = default and UDim2.new(1,-21,0,3)
        or UDim2.new(0,3,0,3)
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = white
    dot.Parent = button
    corner(dot,20)

    local enabled = default

    local function refresh()
        button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and purple
            or Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45)

        dot.Position = enabled and UDim2.new(1,-21,0,3)
            or UDim2.new(0,3,0,3)
    end

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        enabled = not enabled
        refresh()

        if callback then
            callback(enabled)
        end
    end)

    return function(value)
        enabled = value
        refresh()
    end
end

-- DROPDOWNS

local function dropdown(parent,name,options,default,callback)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Name = name
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
    row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Parent = parent

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,5)
    layout.Parent = row

    label(row,name,16,27)

    local selected = default or options[1]
    local expanded = false

    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,36)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(31,31,31)
    button.Text = selected.."     ▼"
    button.TextColor3 = white
    button.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    button.TextSize = 16
    button.LayoutOrder = 2
    button.Parent = row
    corner(button,5)

    local optionList = Instance.new("Frame")
    optionList.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
    optionList.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    optionList.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(19,19,19)
    optionList.Visible = false
    optionList.LayoutOrder = 3
    optionList.Parent = row
    corner(optionList,5)

    local optionLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    optionLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0,3)
    optionLayout.Parent = optionList

    local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,4)
    padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,4)
    padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,4)
    padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,4)
    padding.Parent = optionList

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        expanded = not expanded
        optionList.Visible = expanded
        button.Text = selected..(expanded and "     ▲" or "     ▼")
    end)

    for _,option in ipairs(options) do
        local choice = Instance.new("TextButton")
        choice.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,32)
        choice.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35)
        choice.Text = option
        choice.TextColor3 = white
        choice.Font = Enum.Font.Code
        choice.TextSize = 15
        choice.Parent = optionList
        corner(choice,4)

        choice.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            selected = option
            expanded = false
            optionList.Visible = false
            button.Text = selected.."     ▼"

            if callback then
                callback(option)
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- SLIDERS

local function slider(parent,name,min,max,default,callback)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Name = name
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,65)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Parent = parent

    local heading = label(row,name.."  "..default,16,26)

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,32)
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,25)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
    bar.Parent = row
    corner(bar,5)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min),0,1,0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = purple
    fill.Parent = bar
    corner(fill,5)

    local dragging = false

    local function update(input)
        local percent = math.clamp(
            (input.Position.X-bar.AbsolutePosition.X)
            /bar.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1
        )

        local current = math.floor(min+(max-min)*percent)

        fill.Size = UDim2.new(percent,0,1,0)
        heading.Text = name.."  "..current

        if callback then
            callback(current)
        end
    end

    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

-- ESP SYSTEM

local espObjects = {}

local function getESPColor()
    return espColors[settings.ESPColor] or white
end

local function removeESP(targetPlayer)
    local data = espObjects[targetPlayer]

    if data then
        if data.Billboard then
            data.Billboard:Destroy()
        end
        if data.Highlight then
            data.Highlight:Destroy()
        end
        if data.Box then
            data.Box:Destroy()
        end

        espObjects[targetPlayer] = nil
    end
end

local function hasClearView(character,part)
    if not settings.ESPWallCheck then
        return true
    end

    if not camera or not character or not part then
        return false
    end

    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = part.Position-origin

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
        player.Character
    }

    local result = workspace:Raycast(
        origin,
        direction,
        params
    )

    if not result then
        return true
    end

    return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function createESP(targetPlayer,character)
    removeESP(targetPlayer)

    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not head or not root then
        return
    end

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "BossESPInfo"
    billboard.Adornee = head
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150,48)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.4,0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = not settings.ESPWallCheck
    billboard.MaxDistance = 1000
    billboard.Enabled = false
    billboard.Parent = gui

    local infoFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    infoFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    infoFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,10)
    infoFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
    infoFrame.Parent = billboard
    corner(infoFrame,4)

    local infoLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    infoLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0,0)
    infoLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    infoLayout.Parent = infoFrame

    local function makeInfoLabel(name)
        local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel.Name = name
        textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,16)
        textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLabel.TextColor3 = white
        textLabel.TextSize = 12
        textLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
        textLabel.Text = ""
        textLabel.Parent = infoFrame
        return textLabel
    end

    local nameLabel = makeInfoLabel("PlayerName")
    local distanceLabel = makeInfoLabel("Distance")
    local healthLabel = makeInfoLabel("Health")

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "BossESPHighlight"
    highlight.Adornee = character
    highlight.FillColor = getESPColor()
    highlight.OutlineColor = getESPColor()
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.75
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = settings.ESPWallCheck
        and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
        or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Enabled = false
    highlight.Parent = character

    local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    box.Name = "BossESPBox"
    box.Adornee = root
    box.AlwaysOnTop = not settings.ESPWallCheck
    box.ZIndex = 5
    box.Color3 = getESPColor()
    box.Transparency = 0.55
    box.Visible = false
    box.Parent = root

    local extents = character:GetExtentsSize()

    box.Size = Vector3.new(
        math.clamp(extents.X*0.9,1.8,3.2),
        math.clamp(extents.Y*0.9,4.2,6.2),
        math.clamp(extents.Z*0.9,1.2,2.4)
    )

    espObjects[targetPlayer] = {
        Character = character,
        Billboard = billboard,
        NameLabel = nameLabel,
        DistanceLabel = distanceLabel,
        HealthLabel = healthLabel,
        Highlight = highlight,
        Box = box
    }
end

local function isESPTeammate(targetPlayer)
    if not settings.ESPTeamCheck then
        return false
    end

    return player.Team ~= nil
        and targetPlayer.Team == player.Team
end

local function updateESP()
    for _,targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if targetPlayer ~= player then
            local character = targetPlayer.Character
            local data = espObjects[targetPlayer]

            if character then
                if not data or data.Character ~= character
                or not data.Billboard.Parent then
                    createESP(targetPlayer,character)
                    data = espObjects[targetPlayer]
                end
            end

            if data then
                local humanoid = character
                    and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                local root = character
                    and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                local head = character
                    and character:FindFirstChild("Head")

                local allowed = settings.ESPEnabled
                    and not isESPTeammate(targetPlayer)
                    and humanoid ~= nil
                    and humanoid.Health > 0
                    and root ~= nil
                    and head ~= nil

                local visible = false

                if allowed then
                    visible = hasClearView(character,head)
                end

                if allowed and visible then
                    local color = getESPColor()

                    data.Billboard.Adornee = head
                    data.Billboard.AlwaysOnTop =
                        not settings.ESPWallCheck

                    data.Billboard.Enabled =
                        settings.ShowNames
                        or settings.ShowDistance
                        or settings.ShowHealth

                    data.NameLabel.Visible = settings.ShowNames
                    data.DistanceLabel.Visible = settings.ShowDistance
                    data.HealthLabel.Visible = settings.ShowHealth

                    data.NameLabel.Text = targetPlayer.DisplayName

                    data.DistanceLabel.Text = ""

                    if settings.ShowDistance then
                        local localCharacter = player.Character
                        local localRoot = localCharacter
                            and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                        if localRoot then
                            local distance =
                                (localRoot.Position-root.Position).Magnitude

                            data.DistanceLabel.Text =
                                "Distance: "..math.floor(distance).." studs"
                        else
                            data.DistanceLabel.Text = "Distance: --"
                        end
                    end

                    if settings.ShowHealth then
                        data.HealthLabel.Text =
                            "HP: "..math.ceil(humanoid.Health)
                            .." / "..math.ceil(humanoid.MaxHealth)
                    end

                    data.Highlight.FillColor = color
                    data.Highlight.OutlineColor = color
                    data.Highlight.DepthMode =
                        settings.ESPWallCheck
                        and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
                        or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

                    data.Highlight.Enabled = settings.HighlightESP

                    data.Box.Color3 = color
                    data.Box.AlwaysOnTop =
                        not settings.ESPWallCheck

                    local extents = character:GetExtentsSize()

                    data.Box.Size = Vector3.new(
                        math.clamp(extents.X*0.9,1.8,3.2),
                        math.clamp(extents.Y*0.9,4.2,6.2),
                        math.clamp(extents.Z*0.9,1.2,2.4)
                    )

                    data.Box.Visible = settings.BoxESP
                else
                    data.Billboard.Enabled = false
                    data.Highlight.Enabled = false
                    data.Box.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(targetPlayer)
    removeESP(targetPlayer)

-- PLAYER TARGETING

local currentTarget = nil
local normalIndex = 0
local nextCycle = 0

local function getTargetPart(character)
    if settings.TargetPart == "Head" then
        return character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    elseif settings.TargetPart == "Torso" then
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    else
        return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
end

local function isTeammate(targetPlayer)
    if not settings.TeamCheck then
        return false
    end

    return player.Team ~= nil
        and targetPlayer.Team == player.Team
end

local function passesWallCheck(targetCharacter,targetPart)
    if not settings.WallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = targetPart.Position-origin

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
        player.Character
    }

    local result = workspace:Raycast(
        origin,
        direction,
        params
    )

    if not result then
        return true
    end

    return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter)
end

local function getEligibleTargets()
    local results = {}

    if settings.POVSize <= 0 then
        return results
    end

    local center = camera.ViewportSize/2

    for _,targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if targetPlayer ~= player
        and not isTeammate(targetPlayer) then

            local character = targetPlayer.Character
            local humanoid = character
                and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            local part = character and getTargetPart(character)

            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
            and part and part:IsA("BasePart") then

                local point,onScreen =
                    camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)

                if onScreen then
                    local distance = (
                        Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)-center
                    ).Magnitude

                    if distance <= settings.POVSize
                    and passesWallCheck(character,part) then

                        table.insert(results,{
                            Player = targetPlayer,
                            Character = character,
                            Part = part,
                            Distance = distance
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return results
end

local function selectTarget(results)
    if #results == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    if settings.TargetMode == "Nearest" then
        table.sort(results,function(a,b)
            return a.Distance < b.Distance
        end)

        return results[1]

    elseif settings.TargetMode == "Farthest" then
        table.sort(results,function(a,b)
            return a.Distance > b.Distance
        end)

        return results[1]

    else
        if currentTarget then
            for i,item in ipairs(results) do
                if item.Player == currentTarget then
                    normalIndex = i
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if os.clock() >= nextCycle then
            normalIndex = normalIndex + 1

            if normalIndex > #results then
                normalIndex = 1
            end

            nextCycle = os.clock()+0.8
        end

        return results[normalIndex]
    end
end

RunService:BindToRenderStep(
    "BossScriptsAimAssist",
    Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+1,
    function(dt)

        if not settings.Aimbot then
            currentTarget = nil
            targetMarker.Visible = false
            return
        end

        local results = getEligibleTargets()
        local selected = selectTarget(results)

        if not selected then
            currentTarget = nil
            targetMarker.Visible = false
            return
        end

        currentTarget = selected.Player

        local targetPart = selected.Part

        if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then
            targetMarker.Visible = false
            return
        end

        local point,onScreen =
            camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)

        if not onScreen then
            targetMarker.Visible = false
            return
        end

        targetMarker.Position =
            UDim2.fromOffset(point.X,point.Y)

        targetMarker.Visible = true
        targetLabel.Text = selected.Player.DisplayName

        local desired = CFrame.lookAt(
            camera.CFrame.Position,
            targetPart.Position
        )

        local speed = 31-settings.Smoothness
        local alpha = 1-math.exp(-speed*dt*0.8)

        camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(
            desired,
            math.clamp(alpha,0,1)
        )
    end
)

local function makeDraggable(object,handle)
    local dragging = false
    local startInput
    local startPosition

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragging = true
            startInput = input.Position
            startPosition = object.Position
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then

            local delta = input.Position-startInput

            object.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPosition.X.Scale,
                startPosition.X.Offset+delta.X,
                startPosition.Y.Scale,
                startPosition.Y.Offset+delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end
